description: Management view: usage trends, capacity and licence consumption over a chosen period.

options.content: **All figures are computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right)** — from ${__from:date:DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm} to ${__to:date:DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm}. Use *Last 7 days*, *Last 30 days*… to compare periods. History is kept 60 days. **Usage**: Unused < 10% · Low < 30% · Medium < 60% · High < 80% · OverUsed ≥ 80% (highest of average CPU and average RAM). **Overloaded time** = share of the period with CPU above 80%.

panels.title: Average CPU usage (fleet)
panels.description:
**Average CPU usage of all selected servers.**

- KPI: share of CPU time not idle, averaged over every core of every server.
- Measured on 5-minute windows sampled every 30 minutes.
- Colours: blue < 10% (idle) · green < 60% · yellow < 80% · red ≥ 80%.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time((100 * (1 - sum by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}[5m])) / count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"})))[$__range:30m]))

panels.title: Average RAM usage (fleet)
panels.description:
**Average memory usage of all selected servers.**

- KPI: 1 − (available memory / total memory). *Available* includes cache that Linux can free, so it is the memory really usable by new jobs.
- Colours: blue < 10% · green < 60% · yellow < 80% · red ≥ 80%.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time((100 * (1 - max by(host) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"}) / max by(host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"})))[$__range:30m]))

panels.title: Availability
panels.description:
**Share of the period during which the servers answered the monitoring** (node_exporter reachable every 15 s).

- 100% = never down. 99% over 30 days ≈ 7 hours of unavailability.
- Planned reboots also count as unavailability (a few minutes each).
- Colours: red < 99% · orange < 99.9% · green ≥ 99.9%.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: avg(100 * max by(host) (avg_over_time(up{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Often overloaded servers
panels.description:
**Number of servers that were overloaded more than 10% of the time.**

- Overloaded = CPU above 80% (5-minute average).
- 10% of 30 days ≈ 3 days cumulated at more than 80% CPU.
- These servers are candidates for more capacity or for moving jobs to quieter servers (see the pools table below).

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: count((100 * avg_over_time(((100 * (1 - sum by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}[5m])) / count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}))) > bool 80)[$__range:30m])) > 10) or vector(0)

panels.title: Server ranking over the period
panels.description:
**One line per server, sorted by average CPU. Click a column header to sort differently.**

Hover a column title for its exact definition.

- **Usage** summarises the server: highest of average CPU and average RAM → Unused < 10% · Low < 30% · Medium < 60% · High < 80% · OverUsed ≥ 80%.
- CPU figures use 5-minute windows sampled every 30 minutes; very short spikes may not appear.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: max by(host) (label_replace(avg_over_time((100 * (1 - sum by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}[5m])) / count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"})))[$__range:30m]), "m", "cpu", "", "") or label_replace(avg_over_time((100 * (1 - max by(host) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"}) / max by(host) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"})))[$__range:30m]), "m", "ram", "", ""))

100 * avg_over_time(((100 * (1 - sum by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}[5m])) / count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}))) > bool 80)[$__range:30m])

Average CPU usage over the period (all cores)

panels.title: Pools of identical servers (same cores and RAM)
panels.description:
**Servers are grouped when they have the same number of CPU cores and the same RAM** (rounded to 4 GiB). Click a line to unfold the servers of the pool.

- **Pool avg CPU / RAM**: average of the servers of the pool.
- **Least / Most loaded**: lowest and highest average CPU inside the pool. A big gap between identical servers means the load is badly spread: users could move from the busiest to the quietest one.
- **BogoMips** (inside the pool): CPU speed indicator measured by Linux; identical servers should have close values.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

panels.title: Daily CPU usage per server
panels.description:
**One cell = average CPU usage of one server for one day.**

- Read it as a calendar: columns are days, lines are servers.
- Colours: blue < 10% (idle) · green < 30% · yellow < 60% · orange < 80% · red ≥ 80%.
- Useful to see weekly patterns (weekends), servers idle for weeks, or a server that became saturated.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}[$__interval])) / count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Daily RAM usage per server
panels.description:
**One cell = average memory usage of one server for one day.**

- Same colours as the CPU calendar above.
- A server constantly red needs more RAM or fewer jobs; constantly blue servers are oversized in memory.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by(host) (avg_over_time(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"}[$__interval])) / max by(host) (avg_over_time(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Top 15 users - share of the CPU consumed
panels.description:
**Which users consume the most CPU on the selected servers.**

- KPI: CPU time used by all the processes of a user ÷ CPU time used by all users × 100. The total of all users is 100%.
- Computed day by day from the CPU counters of process-exporter; system accounts (root, sshd, node_exporter) are excluded.
- Numbers instead of names = accounts whose name could not be resolved from the AD.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: topk(15, 100 / scalar(sum_over_time((sum(((namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} - namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} offset 1d) >= 0 or namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"})))[$__range:1d])) * sum by(utilisateur) (label_replace(sum by(utilisateur) (label_replace(sum_over_time((sum by(groupname) (((namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} - namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} offset 1d) >= 0 or namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"})))[$__range:1d]), "utilisateur", "$2", "groupname", "(.+):([^:]+)")) * on(utilisateur) group_left(username) max by(utilisateur, username) (label_replace(node_uid_username{job="node_exporter"}, "utilisateur", "$1", "uid", "(.*)")), "utilisateur", "$1", "username", "(.*)") or (sum by(utilisateur) (label_replace(sum_over_time((sum by(groupname) (((namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} - namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"} offset 1d) >= 0 or namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{job="process_exporter", host=~"$server", groupname!~".*:(root|node_exporter|sshd)"})))[$__range:1d]), "utilisateur", "$2", "groupname", "(.+):([^:]+)")) unless on(utilisateur) max by(utilisateur, username) (label_replace(node_uid_username{job="node_exporter"}, "utilisateur", "$1", "uid", "(.*)")))))

panels.title: Local disks - usage
panels.description:
**Current size and fill level of the local disks** (xfs, ext4…) of the selected servers, fullest first.

- Used = (size − free space) / size.
- Colours: green < 80% · orange < 90% · red ≥ 90%.
- Network shares (NFS…) are not listed here: see the server detail dashboard.

Value at the end of the selected period.

targets.expr: label_join(max by(host, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", fstype=~"ext2|ext3|ext4|xfs|btrfs|zfs"}), "disk", " : ", "host", "mountpoint")

label_join(max by(host, mountpoint) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", fstype=~"ext2|ext3|ext4|xfs|btrfs|zfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node_exporter", host=~"$server", fstype=~"ext2|ext3|ext4|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})), "disk", " : ", "host", "mountpoint")

panels.title: Licence features tracked
panels.description:
**Number of licence features followed by the FlexLM servers** for the selected vendors.

- One feature = one licensed product/option (e.g. a simulator, a toolbox).
- Uncounted / unlimited features are excluded.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: count((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000)

panels.title: Avg fill rate (licences in use)
panels.description:
**How full the licence pools are, on average.**

- KPI: for each feature, average number of licences in use ÷ number of licences owned; then the average of all features that were used at least once.
- Never-used features are counted separately (next tile), so they do not pull the average down.
- Colours: blue < 20% · green < 70% · yellow < 90% · red ≥ 90%.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: avg((100 * (max by(app, name) (avg_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:5m]))) / ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000)) and on(app, name) ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(max_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])[$__range:1d]))) > 0))

panels.title: Never used in the period
panels.description:
**Licence features that nobody checked out during the whole period.**

- These are the first candidates to reduce at the next contract renewal.
- Check over a long period (30 days or more) before deciding: some tools are only used at project milestones.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: count(((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000) unless on(app, name) ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(max_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])[$__range:1d]))) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Saturated features
panels.description:
**Licence features where ALL the licences were in use more than 5% of the time.**

- 5% of 30 days ≈ 36 hours during which a new user could not get a licence.
- Candidates for buying more licences, or for checking that idle sessions are released.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: count((100 * max by(app, name) (avg_over_time(((flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"} >= bool flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}) and on(app, name) (flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"} > 0))[$__range:15m]))) > 5) or vector(0)

panels.title: Distinct licence users
panels.description:
**Number of different people who used at least one licence** of the selected vendors.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: count(max_over_time((count by(user) (count_over_time(flexlm_feature_used_users{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])))[$__range:1d]))

panels.title: Top 10 - most used licences
panels.description:
**The 10 features with the highest average fill rate.**

- Avg fill rate = average licences in use ÷ licences owned.
- A feature close to 100% is fully used and probably blocks users at peak times.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * (max by(app, name) (avg_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:5m]))) / ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000))

panels.title: Top 10 - least used licences (used at least once)
panels.description:
**The 10 features with the lowest average fill rate, among those used at least once.**

- Low fill rate = licences bought but rarely in use at the same time: the number of licences could be reduced.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: bottomk(10, (100 * (max by(app, name) (avg_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:5m]))) / ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000)) and on(app, name) ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(max_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])[$__range:1d]))) > 0))

panels.title: Licences never used in the period
panels.description:
**Purchased licences with zero checkout during the whole period.**

- Licences owned = number of tokens in the licence file.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000) unless on(app, name) ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(max_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])[$__range:1d]))) > 0)

panels.description:
**Features whose licences were all in use at some point.**

- % of time saturated = share of the period during which every licence was taken (checked every 15 minutes).
- Peak in use = highest number of licences used at the same time.
- Distinct users = number of different people who used the feature.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: (100 * max by(app, name) (avg_over_time(((flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"} >= bool flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}) and on(app, name) (flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"} > 0))[$__range:15m]))) > 0

4. **Healthy** – everything else

100 * (max by(app, name) (max_over_time(max_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[1d])[$__range:1d]))) / ((max by(app, name) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__range:6h])) > 0) < 100000)

panels.title: Licence fill rate per vendor over time
panels.description:
**Share of the licences of each vendor in use, hour by hour.**

- KPI: licences in use ÷ licences owned, all features of the vendor together.
- Shows working-hours peaks, weekends and holidays.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: 100 * sum by(app) (avg_over_time(flexlm_feature_used{app=~"$vendor"}[$__interval]) and on(app, name) (flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"} > 0)) / sum by(app) (max_over_time(flexlm_feature_issued{app=~"$vendor"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Top 15 licence users (licence-hours)
panels.description:
**Who holds licences the longest.**

- 1 licence-hour = 1 licence held during 1 hour. Two licences held 3 hours = 6 licence-hours.
- Sum over all features of the selected vendors; based on the 1-minute FlexLM polling, so it is an approximation.

Computed over the period selected in the time picker (top right).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by(user) (sum_over_time((sum by(user) (count_over_time(flexlm_feature_used_users{app=~"$vendor"}[1h])))[$__range:1h])) / 60)

options.content:
| KPI | Definition | Thresholds |
|---|---|---|
| **Avg CPU** | Share of CPU time not idle, averaged over all cores and over the period | 🟦 < 10% · 🟩 < 60% · 🟨 < 80% · 🟥 ≥ 80% |
| **Avg RAM** | 1 − available memory / total memory (cache that Linux can free counts as available) | same as CPU |
| **Usage** | Highest of Avg CPU and Avg RAM | Unused < 10% · Low < 30% · Medium < 60% · High < 80% · OverUsed ≥ 80% |
| **Time overloaded** | Share of the period with CPU above 80% (5-min average) | > 10% = often overloaded |
| **Availability** | Share of the period during which the server answered the monitoring | 🟥 < 99% · 🟧 < 99.9% · 🟩 ≥ 99.9% |
| **Pool** | Servers with the same number of cores and the same RAM | big gap between least/most loaded = load badly spread |
| **User CPU share** | CPU time of a user's processes ÷ CPU time of all users | total = 100% |
| **Licence fill rate** | Licences in use ÷ licences owned | 🟦 < 20% · 🟩 < 70% · 🟨 < 90% · 🟥 ≥ 90% |
| **Saturated licence** | All licences in use more than 5% of the period | users probably had to wait |
| **Never-used licence** | No checkout during the whole period | candidate for reduction |
| **Licence-hour** | 1 licence held during 1 hour | |

*Data: node_exporter (CPU, RAM, disks, availability), process-exporter (CPU per user), flexlm_exporter (licences, polled every minute). History kept 60 days.*

title: CAO Compute - Trends & Capacity
